subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between S and T when counted from the left of T. R sits third to the right of A. U sits third to the left of C. R sits to the immediate right of U. B is not an immediate neighbour of U. How many people sit between B and T when counted from the right of B?
solution:
Given Information:

⇒ Only one person sits between S and T when counted from the left of T.

⇒ R sits third to the right of A. U sits third to the left of C.

⇒ U sits third to the left of C.

⇒&nbs
p;R sits to the immediate right of U.

⇒ B is not an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c2d8dd0702e4cc549ca9cb28918c7e7a74dc9d82ae1a3783386d26e3c06ab85.png] 

Thus, **3 **peoples are sitting between B and T when counted from the right of B from the above given arrangement.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
